# api-key-manager

> Issue, verify, rotate and revoke API keys: prefixed tokens with a CRC32 checksum, peppered HMAC-SHA256 digests at rest, grace-period rotation and a pluggable key store Python package `trysac-api-key-manager`, import name `api_key_manager`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
